tubs.name: L.A. Cholent kit tubs
tubs.traits: four square clear plastic tubs sealed with cling film, the same count of four, full of thick dark red-brown raw cholent kit (grains and beans, as seen through the tub, never smoother or more orange); on each lid the black label 'L.A. CHOLENT By Rabbi Samuels' with the recipe steps and 'Yields approx. 3-4 pounds', sharp and readable. No added tubs or copies.
tubs.source: their own photo (docs/ads/gen/la-cholent-status/gen.py:5, scrollcraft/builds/la-cholent/gen/tubs-brief.md:6-7); mistakes: a label came out reading 'Stir wall' and the fill too smooth and orange (tubs-brief.md:9-10). The slow cooker in assets/pot.webp is generated, not theirs.
